subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises common consonant digraphs (sh, ch, th) at the beginning of a word

show.line: Two letters, one sound! s and h together say sh. sh, sh, ship. Quiet like a library!

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with sh, as in ship?
Say the sound with me. sh, as in ship!
Listen. sh, e, ll. What word is it?
Tap the letters that say sh.
rounds.praise: s and h together say sh.

rounds.prompt: Which one does not start with sh?
Does it start with sh or just s? Sort the pictures.

hints: sh is the quiet sound. Finger on your lips. sh!
s and h together make one new sound.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with sh.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Sock starts with s. Ship starts with sh.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. sh, sh, ship. Ship starts with sh!

parent_line: Can hear and read the sh sound at the start of words.
